description: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications through an overview of computer vision concepts and application areas.

Understand image formation concepts, including image representation, geometric primitives and transformations, photometric image formation, lighting, image acquisition through digital cameras, and camera calibration foundations.

Apply basic image processing techniques and corresponding algorithms for point and line operations, image filtering, Fourier transforms, geometric transformations, and point or patch-based image processing.
Understand feature extraction and matching techniques, including points and patches, and implement edge and line extraction techniques.
Understand the basics of image segmentation, including active contours, split and merge, mean shift, and mode finding.
Discuss feature-based alignment, including 2D and 3D feature-based alignment.
Discuss the principles and implementation of image stitching, including motion models and global alignment.
Understand and implement object detection techniques.
Explain the principles of face recognition and object tracking techniques.
